Insight Identification

Name the 100° angle, then notice collinearity

The calculated 100° is ∠OXD. Because E, X, O are collinear, ∠OXD and ∠EXD form a linear pair.

Operation Prescription

One subtraction — nothing else

Subtract ∠OXD from 180°.

Operation Execution

Complete the linear pair

∠EXD = 180° − 100° = 80°.

∠EXD = 80°
